## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy` are clean (if `src-tauri/` changed)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG `Unreleased` section updated where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in code, tests or sample data
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
